decisions.rule: Vercel cloud API; Atlas canonical; outbound Mac only
Exactly player/parent/coach; equal authorized parents and tenant coaches
Direct child submissions immediately parent-visible; coach material publication separate
Single existing qwen2.5:7b/shared lock; no new embedding/cloud fallback
Player direct AI deferred; reviewed retrieval learning not weight training
Hungarian product; shared accepted HABI-inspired visual language
Contract v2, daily-v1, strict-template release, manual extraction first
Population aggregate learning, long-horizon auto-programmes, HABI account merge

Role administration is separate from player/parent/coach; only DoneIsBetter Habi app admins may issue one-time role invitations, claimed by the recipient after SSO with exact verified identity and no email matching
Legacy browser-owned records do not block new Habi onboarding and are not transferred into new role accounts

Hosted Habi interpretation jobs use the shared Hetzner text_chat async API with model auto by default; only the requester-authorized, revision-pinned source bundle is sent server-to-server; Habi validates exact citations and current revisions before accepting results; local synthetic/test modes remain local
supersedes: D-HG-011 local model for hosted interpretation
D-HG-012 no personal hosted AI fallback

decisions.rule: Contextual AI coach is available to authenticated players, parents and coaches on all workspace pages. Actor-and-role-scoped private dialogue, source-backed player memory, explicit corrections, authored practice recommendations and feedback are enabled. Only an explicitly shared turn and its sources enter human review; personal inference remains separate until reviewed. Learning updates retrieved player memory, not model weights.
decisions.authority: Owner request 2026-10-27: deliver all contextual AI coach, player memory and recommendations
